flags.title: Prior published card was a 26 October snapshot
flags.detail: data/events.json and the root dashboard carry retrieved_at 2026-10-26. This desk uses a fresh 27 October transcription (143 OLBG rows) plus 50 rows read from OLBG event pages and official fixtures. Tip splits changed substantially: India moved from 27/40 to 35/49, Afghanistan from 8/9 to 15/16, Pakistan from 14/21 to 22/31.

flags.title: Earlier board contains stale, contradictory World Series claims
flags.detail: data/picks_610d0099.json says Milwaukee led 2-0 before Game 3 on 26 October and describes Freddy Peralta as a Rays pitcher with a 2-0 record and 1.08 playoff ERA. MLB.com's official schedule now shows Milwaukee winning Game 3 10-1 to lead 3-0, and its report says Peralta was charged with the eight-run fifth inning. Those earlier rows must not be republished as current.

flags.title: OLBG handball hub shows 'Tie' as the most-tipped selection
flags.detail: Thirteen of the 27 October handball rows list 'Tie' as the selected outcome with tip shares up to 78%. This is a rendering artefact of the hub's most-tipped-outcome display, not a usable market consensus. Here those matches are priced as three-way contests and the straight win is picked using EHF's official group table.

flags.title: OLBG has no snooker or greyhound tips today
flags.detail: Both hubs returned 'No tips found.' on 27 October. The picks on this desk for those sports come from WST's official match centre/rankings and Romford Stadium's official advance card, not from OLBG markets. They are labelled and must not be described as OLBG community picks.

flags.title: PDC sources conflict on Players Championship event numbering
flags.detail: A PDC article dated 26 October announces Players Championships 31-32 for 28-29 October, but another PDC article dated the same day lists 2026 PC event winners through event 32 (Jeffrey de Graaf 31, Gabriel Clemens 32). An OLBG tipster comment also credits Wessel Nijman with six 2026 PC titles, which does not match PDC's own winner list. All darts form claims are flagged where they come from community comments.

flags.title: Market label for the Verstappen Mexico row differs between captures
flags.detail: The 27 October hub row 007 names the market 'Podium Finish' with selection 'Max Verstappen - Yes' at 1/2 tips, while the earlier root inventory called this event's market 'Top 6 Finish'. The market name is left exactly as captured on 27 October and the discrepancy is recorded here.

flags.title: Earlier outright lines used a 1/8 prior for large fields
flags.detail: Earlier boards priced outright markets with a 1/8 structural prior even for fields of 100+ runners, which produced unrealistically short prices on longshots. This desk uses official field sizes where published (120 for the Mexico Open, 54 for the Simmons Bank Championship, 128 for Players Championship 31) and a documented shrinkage constant. Where a field size was not published it is left blank and flagged.

flags.title: No bookmaker odds in retrievable OLBG HTML
flags.detail: OLBG's rendered pages show tip counts and percentages but no bookmaker price in the HTML we can retrieve, so the bookmaker_odds column is blank throughout and no price-comparison claim is made. One exception: the PGA TOUR's own betting article publishes FanDuel prices for the Mexico Open, which are quoted on the golf rows as a published benchmark, not as an OLBG price.

flags.title: Injury and team-news fields are blank
flags.detail: No official injury report or confirmed team sheet was retrieved for the majority of events. Injury and team-news cells are intentionally blank rather than filled with speculation; each affected pick carries the injury-news-blank flag. Where an official source did name a starter (MLB Game 4, WST draw, PDC entries), that fact is stated with its link.

flags.title: Start times have no published timezone
flags.detail: OLBG prints 'Today 21:00', 'Tomorrow 08:00' and similar labels without a timezone. The timezone field is blank on all captured rows. WST's match centre shows round-two snooker at 21:30 on 30 October while a specialist draw lists 01:30Z on 31 October, so exact start times are left as displayed and not converted.

flags.title: Hub shows one tipped name per golf tournament; event pages show two
flags.detail: The OLBG golf hub lists one 1/2 selection per tournament, but the three event pages each show two players on one tip apiece (Woad/Choi, Clark/Homa, Cink/Els). Both tipped names are priced here with the event-page URL attached, because the hub's single-name display hides half the market.

flags.title: Opponent world rankings come from a specialist draw list
flags.detail: WST publishes the official top rankings (Selby 4, Murphy 7, Wu 2, Wilson 9), but rankings for players outside the top eleven such as Mitchell Mann, Liam Davies and Liu Hongyu were only available on snooker.org's draw page. Those numbers are labelled secondary and are not presented as official WST figures.

flags.title: Advance racecard has no form figures
flags.detail: Romford's official advance card publishes trap draws, trainers, grades and race times but no recent form, sectional times or injury notes. Greyhound selections are therefore made from the trap draw plus OLBG's own Romford trap-1 statistic, and every such pick is low confidence.

flags.title: Several earlier rows cite Wikipedia or aggregator pages
flags.detail: The first board's snooker, Gaelic and golf rows cite Wikipedia, Golf News Net and similar secondary pages. Where this desk reuses a fact of that type it is labelled secondary in the sources table and flagged on the row; official governing-body links were substituted wherever one was available.

flags.title: Four separate boards exist in this repository
flags.detail: The root dashboard, /docs/, /olbg-tips/ and /docs/board-review/ each publish their own version of the card, which is the source of the confusion reported by the user. This desk is a single self-contained board with one pick table, one lines table, one sources page and one flagged page. A link from the root dashboard is requested in COORDINATION.md rather than editing another session's page.

flags.title: Ante-post markets extend into 2027
flags.detail: Rows such as the 2027 World Cup, State of Origin 2027, NRL 2027 and the 2027 All-Ireland championships are long-dated. They are kept because OLBG lists them, but their confidence is capped at medium and they are excluded from the today-only executive summary.

flags.title: Prices shorter than -250 or longer than +10000 are floored or capped
flags.detail: The coverage brief asks for high-confidence picks between -250 and +10000. Where our fair price falls outside that range the published line is floored at 1.40 or capped at 101.00, the fair price is retained in the data, and the row is flagged band-floor-applied or band-cap-applied. Nothing is silently rounded into the band.
